articles.title: Recent Op-Eds, Opinion Pieces & Articles Worth Reading
articles.summary: An article by Rudramani Pokherel in The Himalayan Times delves into Nepal's sensitive national symbol debate, focusing on the cow and the rhino. The discussion, considered almost taboo, explores the significance of each contender, including the cow's traditional holiness. This piece prompts reflection on Nepal's identity and its symbolic representation.

articles.title: Defence ministry invites firms to design, develop airship-based high-altitude pseudo sats under Rs 15,000cr program
articles.summary: India's Defence Ministry is seeking domestic firms to develop airship-based pseudo satellites. These platforms will provide persistent intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, offering a cost-effective alternative to conventional satellite systems. This initiative aims to bolster India's strategic monitoring capabilities with indigenous technology, ensuring continuous surveillance for national security purposes and reducing reliance on existing space-based assets.

articles.title: Olentangy Orange wrestler Mackenzie Carder wins national title
articles.summary: Olentangy Orange wrestler Mackenzie Carder has achieved national champion status, a significant milestone following her first OHSAA state championship win in March. Carder triumphed in the 125-pound category, demonstrating exceptional skill and dedication in her sport. This accomplishment highlights her consistent high-level performance and embodies the spirit of perseverance often valued in leadership roles.

articles.title: Canada's 2026 Wildfire Season Has Surged Far Beyond Historical Averages
articles.summary: Canada is grappling with a rapidly escalating national emergency, as what began as a below-average wildfire season has erupted into a crisis. Over 900 active wildfires are burning across the country as of mid-July 2026, posing significant challenges. This situation underscores the growing global concern over environmental disasters and their widespread impact.
